source_derivation: Derived from original html/flex/fri07_flex_composition.html SHA-256 19acedc9894eed500890b91f48f9eb0e7f19a3db440f06cbaa6356e7ce73192e and scripts/gentest/test_base_style.css SHA-256 5d00a3f3c55322b7002b065eacc6b4f3f14ecad83f757c79679b6ec6dee4fec6, without any completed batch or browser expectation input. Pinned CSS Writing Modes 4 physical mapping and CSS Flexbox 1 (2025-10-14) sections 4.4 and 9.4 plus Layout's flexbox-collapse-two-round-struts policy. The sideways-rl column-reverse root collects image, scroller, collapsed item, and opposite-block-progression item along +x. First-round cross sizes 80,30,40 plus two gaps of 6 stretch by 6 each, giving a 36px strut. Replay keeps collection gaps, so 116+6>120 starts a line with the zero-main strut and the 40px item. Line sizes 80,40 plus one gap of 6 stretch by 27 each. Definite item heights align at wrap-reversed cross-start. The collapsed slot and its descendant publish hidden packets with their source indices. The nested scroller has a 70x60 border box, 50px leftward block overflow from the 120px definite cross width, and one 15px classic gutter at Native inline-end (scroll/box_geometry.rs). Its empty child shrinks from 100px to 45px and starts at scrollport y=0 in LTR or y=15 in RTL. CSS Overflow 3 section 4.2 leaves scrollbar edge placement UA-defined. The parent's complete envelope unions the child with the padding seed. Its operational range independently excludes the gutter. The SVG has natural size 80x40. The source-bound replaced leaf retains authored 40x80 allocation. Per measurement.rs the perform-layout callback has no known content sizes, so flex_composition.rs returns the natural size. scroll/construction.rs places the measured rectangle against physical right and inline-start. Union with the padding seed gives local envelope (-40,0,80,80) and content_size 80x80. Captured normalized image Clip/Clip uses content-box plus zero margin. Both ranges are zero, and the complete image envelope does not propagate to the root through Clip. The measured leaf issues Unknown named facts. The performed empty Flex items issue Absent named facts, and nonempty Flex and hidden packets retain Unknown. Initial scroll padding and target margins are zero. No snap facts are enabled. Every coordinate and extent is integral in both packet phases.
